title: Lunar regolith
description: Raking light reveals a rough mineral moon against an icy white field.
useCase: Space, materials science, and quiet editorial illustrations.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Invented terrain and crater-like detail, not geographic or lunar scan data.
look: A rough grey-brown pitted sphere with bump-shaded mineral texture, lit from the upper left and fading to black, centred on a pale icy blue-grey field.
motion: The sphere's procedural rock surface slowly rotates in longitude while raking light shades its bumps; a sun-angle slider swings the light horizontally across it.
adapt: Terrain is `rock` (layered `grain` noise) in the `FRAGMENT` shader; `u_time*.025` sets spin speed, `radius` the size, and `light` maps `u_control` to the sun direction. Recolour the `vec3(.54,.51,.46)` rock tint and background `c`; keep the WebGL lifecycle.
